stories.title: Gary Speed: 15 years since death of Deeside-born Wales manager
stories.summary: It is 15 years today since Mancot-born Gary Speed died while he was manager of Wales. He died on 27 November 2011, aged 42. stories.title: Deeside circuit board maker awarded £150k to help safeguard 77 jobs
stories.summary: A Deeside circuit board maker has been awarded £154,784 by the Welsh Government for new manufacturing technology, which it says will help safeguard 77 skilled jobs. Merlin Circuit Technology makes printed circuit boards, known as PCBs, for high-reliability sectors including aerospace and advanced engineering. The Welsh Government said the investment is expected to quadruple production

stories.title: Suspended North Wales Police officer denies rape and sexual assault charges
stories.summary: A suspended North Wales Police officer has pleaded not guilty to rape and three counts of sexual assault at Mold Crown Court. stories.title: £10.5m upgrade under way at Mold wastewater treatment works
stories.summary: Welsh Water is spending £10.5 million on upgrading Mold’s wastewater treatment works. The works serves 8,000 homes and businesses in the town.
